interpretation: "raw spo2 helper" = a non-attention native entry of the spo2 module (rotate, prepare, append, int4_stats, eb2b_quantize, eb2b_values). The five attention entries already refuse empty extents on the host before any launch; their exception type (RuntimeError, chosen by F1 R11 for dense-entry parity) is left unchanged (deviation D2 in REPORT.md asks the lead to rule).

eb3_timeline.templates: byG: a timeline select has ON=true, so REG is false and only the G=2/G=4 cases launch; variants allowed a timeline are 0 (registered select options, ON), 1 (occupancy-only) and 6 (baseline footprint, sel=2); ablation variants were already limited to G=2,4 before any launch
eb3_timeline.f1_behaviour: passed every early check, launched rotation and bulk, then byG threw "G not instantiated for this variant" (REV2 F05)
eb3_timeline.f2_behaviour: ValueError before the ticket lock, the arena and any launch
